summary: Well-executed, preregistered paired NetOpsTraceBench run with complete archival artifacts and appropriate confirmatory analysis for pooled paired binary outcomes. Major reproducibility and accounting are present, but the preregistered topology‑cluster confirmatory hypothesis (H3) is not executed/archived and the manuscript still implies a per‑cluster confirmatory comparison.
critical_issues: The preregistered topology‑cluster confirmatory hypothesis (H3) was not executed/archived, but the manuscript language implies a completed per‑cluster confirmatory comparison. This is a material preregistration fidelity and reporting mismatch that must be corrected.

Manuscript statements that suggest results “across two simulated topologies” are misleading given that only the pooled paired analysis was archived and reported; this could lead readers to overinterpret generality across topology clusters.
required_revisions: Add an explicit, prominent disclosure in Methods and/or Results stating that the preregistered topology‑cluster breakdown (H3) was not executed/archived. If H3 was intentionally deferred, state this clearly and cite the archived pooled‑analysis artifacts as the complete confirmatory record.

Remove or qualify any wording that implies a completed per‑cluster confirmatory inference. Replace such phrasing with accurate statements that the confirmatory inference is pooled and that per‑cluster analyses were not performed (or point to archived per‑cluster artifacts if they do exist).

Add a short pointer in Methods or the Disclosure Statement to the archived pooled analysis artifacts that support the primary result (e.g., analysis/paired_contingency_table.csv, analysis/condition_summary.csv, analysis/results.json, execution/execution_manifest.json) so readers can verify that only the pooled confirmatory analysis is archived.
optional_revisions: Add a brief paragraph (one short paragraph) clarifying why the shared_initial_candidate paired design was chosen and how that choice likely reduced repair invocation and affects external validity (can be supported by existing repair stage_counts and representative scoring artifacts).

Optionally include a concise per‑difficulty summary (or explicit pointer to deterministic_reconciliation.json and the difficulty_summary) to help readers assess corpus composition and its relation to near‑ceiling baseline performance.
